mentions.description: A personal home lab project: piecing together a SAN and some compute from old parts the author has lying around plus second-hand servers, housed in a new rack, alongside setting up a bespoke home network instead of relying on ISP-provided equipment.
mentions.problem: The author's needs and preferences have outgrown commodity systems and default setups, and although they have long been averse to configuration and customization, AI is making it much easier to customize systems.
mentions.audience: The builder themselves — described as a personal project after over 35 years of using computers.
mentions.author: rjbwork
